failure.action: terminated stalled owned test process after repeated no-progress observations

root_mechanisms: Stop predicate changed without the wait mutex, allowing a missed wakeup between predicate check and entering wait.
Worker vector declared before synchronization members, so automatic member destruction could destroy state before joining workers.
change: Request stop while holding the wait mutex, notify after unlocking, explicitly join all workers before member destruction.
interpretation: The isolated lifecycle stress reproduces the shutdown defect and passes after the synchronization fix. This does not establish that earlier Tier-1 timeouts were deadlocks; their traces showed active search.
